Market today:
The S&P 500 is hitting record highs, suggesting strong bullish momentum. However, rising oil prices and Treasury yields, coupled with upcoming inflation data, are creating underlying caution, especially for growth-oriented tech and chip names.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-48.92%) and SPAL (-39.96%) are your most concerning positions due to significant losses and their leveraged nature, which amplifies drawdowns on margin. SMH (-10.52%) also needs attention with its 'TRIM' status.

Watch:
Keep an eye on Intel's $20 billion stock offering and its potential ripple effects on the chip sector. Also, monitor the upcoming inflation data, as it will heavily influence Treasury yields and tech valuations.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions given the current market crosscurrents.
plays: SOXL: Your -48.92% loss on this leveraged ETF is significant. Consider a tighter stop, perhaps around 125, to protect against further decay and downside.
SPAL: This leveraged ETF is down -39.96%. Its current stop at 21.38 is above the price of 15.1. Re-evaluate and set a protective stop below current price, e.g., 14.5.
CRDO: The scanner shows an 'ACCUMULATE' setup (10/12) for this semiconductor name. Consider a new buy at entry 239.7-239.46 with a stop at 238.62.
